mapper.select: select m.id,m.music_name,m.album_id,m.musician_id,m.duration,m.cover_url,m.is_vip,m.status, u.username as musicianName, a.album_name,l.updated_time from music as m left join user as u on m.musician_id=u.id left join album as a on m.album_id=a.id left join like_record l on m.id=l.target_id where m.id=#{targetId} and l.user_Id=#{userId}

select m.id,m.music_name,m.album_id,m.musician_id,m.duration,m.cover_url,m.is_vip,m.status, u.username as musicianName, a.album_name, l.updated_time from music as m left join user as u on m.musician_id=u.id left join album as a on m.album_id=a.id left join like_record l on m.id=l.target_id where l.user_id=#{userId} and l.is_canceled=0 order by l.updated_time desc
